investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Amberpoint Networks (mobile operator); Platform: AWS ca-central-1 (zones ca-central-1a/ca-central-1b/ca-central-1d); network range 10.238.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster amberp-prod-cacent (EKS); Automation: an in-house node-recycler controller rotates worker nodes (cordon, drain, terminate, replace) in batches bounded by maxUnavailable (10% of 14 nodes); runs are recorded with RECYCLE- identifiers; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
